_published_faq.name: How do I add adobe-llm-apps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add adobe-llm-apps to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://4189989-prod6700765a-stage.adobeio-static.net/api/v1/web/llm-apps/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is adobe-llm-apps MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 15, 2026, adobe-llm-apps scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is adobe-llm-apps's MCP tool documentation?
